numerical_claims.source_evidence: Note 6 tables show total borrowings at 30 June 2026: 57,341 thousand euros, with the exact breakdown matching the reported figures for construction, development, bonds and investor loans

candidate_sentences.text: Total loan liabilities reached 57,341 thousand euros at the end of the quarter, consisting of 16,561 thousand euros in construction bank loans, 19,542 thousand euros in development bank loans, 14,885 thousand euros in bonds, and 6,353 thousand euros in investor loans.

verified_key_information_units.information: Q2 2026 revenue decreased to EUR 4.5 million from EUR 7.4 million in Q2 2025, with profit before tax of EUR -234 thousand versus EUR 1.0 million in Q2 2025, resulting in a net loss of EUR 618 thousand compared to a net profit of EUR 974 thousand in Q2 2025. The loss was impacted by EUR 384 thousand income tax expense on dividends and approximately EUR 90 thousand offering-related costs.
verified_key_information_units.source_evidence: Management report, Overview section; Consolidated statement of comprehensive income

candidate_sentences.text: For the second quarter of 2026 specifically, revenue stood at 4,503 thousand euros, declining from 7,388 thousand euros in the second quarter of 2025.
Profit before tax for the second quarter was minus 234 thousand euros compared to 1,002 thousand euros in the prior year period.

Following income tax expenses of 384 thousand euros on dividends, the net loss for the second quarter of 2026 was 618 thousand euros, reflecting a decline from a net profit of 974 thousand euros in the second quarter of 2025.

verified_key_information_units.information: For the first six months of 2026, revenue increased to EUR 11.4 million from EUR 9.3 million in the same period of 2025, with profit before tax of EUR 186 thousand versus EUR 296 thousand, and a net loss of EUR 198 thousand compared to a net profit of EUR 268 thousand.
verified_key_information_units.source_evidence: Management report, Overview section; Consolidated statement of comprehensive income

candidate_sentences.text: For the six-month period ending June 30, 2026, the group reported consolidated revenue of 11,439 thousand euros, representing an increase compared to 9,319 thousand euros for the first six months of 2025.

Operating profit for the six-month period was 341 thousand euros, compared with 325 thousand euros a year earlier, while profit before tax reached 186 thousand euros compared to 296 thousand euros in the first half of 2025.

Due to income tax expenses of 384 thousand euros incurred in connection with dividends paid during the quarter, the group recorded a net loss of 198 thousand euros for the six-month period, which compares to a net profit of 268 thousand euros for the first six months of 2025.

verified_key_information_units.information: In Q2 2026, Liven signed 57 sales contracts totaling EUR 13.2 million in new sales revenue, with a presale portfolio of EUR 48.6 million across 171 contracts entering Q3 2026, of which EUR 39.8 million related to projects completing in 2026.
verified_key_information_units.source_evidence: Management report, Overview section (including note that 3 contracts were in Berlin)

candidate_sentences.text: During the second quarter of 2026, the group signed 57 sales contracts under the law of obligations compared to 31 contracts in the second quarter of 2025.

The group entered the third quarter of 2026 with 171 contracts under the law of obligations and a presale volume of 48.6 million euros, of which 39.8 million euros relate to buildings scheduled for completion in 2026.

verified_key_information_units.information: Liven handed over 12 homes in Q2 2026, down from 35 in Q2 2025, with a total of 26 homes and commercial units handed over in the first six months of 2026 compared to 41 in the same period of 2025.

candidate_sentences.text: Conversely, the handover of completed homes slowed during the second quarter, with only 12 homes handed over compared to 35 homes in the second quarter of 2025, bringing the total number of handovers for the first six months of 2026 to 26 homes compared to 41 homes in the first six months of 2025.

verified_key_information_units.information: As of 30 June 2026, Liven's balance sheet showed cash and cash equivalents of EUR 10.0 million, total assets of EUR 100.2 million, total liabilities of EUR 73.4 million, and equity of EUR 26.7 million, with construction loans amounting to EUR 16.6 million.
verified_key_information_units.source_evidence: Consolidated statement of financial position; Note 6 for construction loans

verified_key_information_units.information: Liven completed an initial public offering in April-May 2026, raising EUR 4.9 million through the issuance of new shares and listed its shares on the Nasdaq Tallinn Baltic Main List on 15 May 2026. Additionally, EUR 1.36 million in dividends was paid during the period.
verified_key_information_units.source_evidence: Management report, Overview and Shareholders sections (including details of share price, number of shares, and dividend payment)

candidate_sentences.text: During the second quarter and first six months of 2026, Liven AS experienced a strong recovery in residential real estate demand, accompanied by key corporate milestones including the initial public offering of its shares and their admission to the Baltic Main List of the Nasdaq Tallinn Stock Exchange on May 15, 2026.

verified_key_information_units.information: During Q2 2026, Liven expanded its Berlin portfolio by acquiring two development properties: Plantagenstraße 19 for EUR 1.7 million and Reichstraße 101 for EUR 1.2 million, planning nearly 20 residential units each with construction scheduled to start at the end of 2027 and the beginning of 2028, respectively.
verified_key_information_units.source_evidence: Management report, Overview section (including total project investment amounts over EUR 11 million and approximately EUR 8 million)

verified_key_information_units.information: Following the reporting period in July 2026, Liven signed a contract to acquire development properties at Pärnu maantee 35, 37, and 41 in Tallinn for EUR 10 million, with plans for over 160 residential and commercial units.
verified_key_information_units.source_evidence: Management report, Events after the reporting period section

verified_key_information_units.information: Market dynamics in Q2 2026 showed a weekly sales ratio of nearly 3.1%, exceeding the long-term normal range of 1.5–2.0%, with Liven holding over 8% market share in Greater Tallinn during the first six months of 2026.
verified_key_information_units.source_evidence: Management report, Overview and Economic environment sections (including supporting factors such as recovering household purchasing power and unified tax-free minimum wage)

candidate_sentences.text: Demand recovery drove the weekly sales ratio above the long-term normal range of 1.5 to 2.0 percent to nearly 3.1 percent as a four-week average, supported by presales in projects such as Regati phase II, Iseära, and Kadakadabra phase I.

verified_key_information_units.information: Liven's outlook for the remainder of 2026 indicates that nearly 90% of its EUR 59 million revenue target has been secured through realized revenue and contracts, with expectations for increasing revenue and net profit in H2 2026, aiming to exceed the 20% return on equity target.

details.completeness_justification: The candidate summary adequately covers K1 (Q2 2026 revenue, profit, and loss details), K2 (first six months revenue and profit comparison), K3 (Q2 2026 sales contracts and presale portfolio), K4 (home handovers), K6 (IPO details), and K9 (market dynamics including sales ratio). However, it omits critical HIGH-importance information from K5 (balance sheet details as of 30 June 2026), K10 (outlook and revenue target secured), and MEDIUM-importance details from K7 (Berlin property acquisitions) and K8 (Tallinn property acquisition contract). The absence of K5 and K10, both HIGH importance, significantly impacts the overall financial picture and forward outlook, resulting in a Neutral/Mixed assessment.

coherence_issues.description: The summary does not explain the cause of the significant drop in profit before tax and net loss between the first half of 2026 and the second quarter of 2026. While S7 mentions one-off administrative and distribution costs related to the public offering, this is only referenced for the second quarter operating loss and does not account for the larger year-over-year declines in profit before tax and net loss figures.

candidate_sentences.text: Operating profit for the six-month period was 341 thousand euros, compared with 325 thousand euros a year earlier, while profit before tax reached 186 thousand euros compared to 296 thousand euros in the first half of 2025.

Due to income tax expenses of 384 thousand euros incurred in connection with dividends paid during the quarter, the group recorded a net loss of 198 thousand euros for the six-month period, which compares to a net profit of 268 thousand euros for the first six months of 2025.
Profit before tax for the second quarter was minus 234 thousand euros compared to 1,002 thousand euros in the prior year period.

Following income tax expenses of 384 thousand euros on dividends, the net loss for the second quarter of 2026 was 618 thousand euros, reflecting a decline from a net profit of 974 thousand euros in the second quarter of 2025.

details.coherence_justification: The candidate summary is generally coherent with a clear narrative structure tracking financial performance, operational metrics, and key corporate events. There are no self-contradictions or major organizational issues. The primary coherence concern is a logical gap in explaining the year-over-year decline in profit before tax and net loss figures, particularly the lack of connection between the one-off costs mentioned in S7 and the larger declines reported in S3, S4, S8, and S9. While the summary effectively tracks performance metrics and provides context for certain changes (e.g., demand recovery, contract signings, asset growth), this specific gap prevents full internal logical coherence.
